hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue from financial data and trading platforms is the primary structural driver of growth and margin, capturing the digital transformation of markets.

kpis.name: Annualized Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue generated by subscriptions to financial data and analytical tools.
kpis.description: LSEG derives over 80% of its revenue from recurring services related to data and analytics.
kpis.signal: Stable growth of the recurring model, core of the business.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross margin after direct costs of services delivered.
kpis.description: Reflection of a low variable cost and highly scalable model.
kpis.signal: High margin typical of financial data players.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Margin strengthened by post-Refinitiv acquisition synergies.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development spending in revenue.
kpis.description: Focus on software innovation and cloud integration.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in data and analytics platforms.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Support for scalability of technology platforms.
kpis.signal: Capex directed toward data infrastructure and cloud.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount stabilized after post-merger integration phase.
kpis.signal: Moderate workforce growth tied to Refinitiv integration.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to predictive analytics and AI APIs on LSEG platforms.
kpis.description: Growth driven by AI integration in pricing, risk, and ESG tools.
kpis.signal: Rapid adoption of AI tools in client workflows.

kpis.name: Share of Deals Including AI Features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts including AI modules.
kpis.description: LSEG integrates AI into its data analytics and regulatory reporting solutions.
kpis.signal: AI has become standard in new cloud offerings.

ai_positioning.summary: LSEG adopts a strategy of integrating AI into its financial data platforms, without being a technology pioneer. The focus is on practical application of AI to enhance analytics, risk, and ESG.
evidence: AI API call volume grew 45% in 2024
38% of new cloud deals include AI features
AI integration in Refinitiv Eikon and Datastream tools
